reference_sql:
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, start_date,
       MIN(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS channel_first_start
FROM campaigns
alternatives:
WITH channel_start AS (  -- one row per channel with campaigns
  SELECT channel_id, MIN(start_date) AS first_start
  FROM campaigns
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.start_date, cs.first_start AS channel_first_start
FROM campaigns c
JOIN channel_start cs ON cs.channel_id = c.channel_id

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.start_date,
       (SELECT MIN(c2.start_date) FROM campaigns c2 WHERE c2.channel_id = c.channel_id) AS channel_first_start
FROM campaigns c

other_way.sql:
WITH channel_start AS (  -- one row per channel with campaigns
  SELECT channel_id, MIN(start_date) AS first_start
  FROM campaigns
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.start_date, cs.first_start AS channel_first_start
FROM campaigns c
JOIN channel_start cs ON cs.channel_id = c.channel_id
other_way.tradeoff: A per-channel step with the earliest date, joined back, works on any engine, but adds a step and a join.
